title: Renew a motor vehicle repairer licence
summary: You can renew your motor vehicle repairer licence online if you have received a renewal notice.
intro:
If you hold a motor vehicle repairer licence and you've received your renewal notice, you can renew online.

Before you renew, check that your business premises details stated on the renewal notice are up to date. You must change the details of your premises if they are not correct.

To find your motor vehicle repairer licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Must hold a motor vehicle repairer licence and have received a renewal notice.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details
Payment for the renewal fee (payable for each place of business, including mobile workshops)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to renew your licence.

more_info.text: If you did not renew on time but the licence is within 3 months from its expiry date you may be able make an application to restore your licence.
If your licence has expired more than 3 months, you'll need to apply for a new licence to be re-issued.
You cannot trade until your new licence is issued.

faqs.q: What should I do before I renew my licence?
faqs.a: Check that the business premises details on your renewal notice are up to date. If they are not correct, you must change the details of your premises.

faqs.q: How do I find my licence number and details?
faqs.a: Visit Verify NSW to find your motor vehicle repairer licence number and details.

faqs.q: How do I renew my licence?
faqs.a: Select the 'Renew online' button and follow the prompts to renew your licence.
